title: Ethics in Counseling
welcome: Ethics is not a list of rules to fear; it is a discipline of love to master. This course forms your professional conscience.
vignette: A mother asks you, in the hallway, what her daughter said in session. The question is casual. The answer is anything but. In that moment, an entire code of ethics becomes one sentence you must choose.
vignette_attr: A corridor moment, drawn from supervised practice
description: A comprehensive study of professional ethics in counseling children and adolescents: confidentiality and its limits, consent and assent, boundaries and dual relationships, mandated reporting and child protection, and culturally humble, faith-informed ethical decision-making using structured models.
questions: What do I owe the child, the parent, and the law, when they conflict?
Where is the line between warmth and boundary?
How do I decide when no option feels clean?
importance: Minors cannot protect themselves; the counselor's ethics is their safety net
Most licensing complaints are ethical failures, not skill failures
Ethical clarity frees you to be fully present with the client
misconceptions: that ethics is common sense, when it is a trained discipline with its own literature
that rules give easy answers, when the hard cases require structured judgment
figures: whose foundational framework of moral principles still organizes the field
who insisted that ethics be read through culture and context
The ACA and BACP code drafters
whose living documents translate values into enforceable standards
outcomes: Master major ethics codes and standards
You will navigate ACA and related codes with confidence and precision.
You will run a dilemma through an explicit, defensible model step by step.
Navigate confidentiality and consent with minors
You will balance the child's trust, parental rights, and legal duties.
You will know exactly when and how to report, and how to tell the child.
You will design personal policies that protect clients and yourself.
You will apply codes across cultures without imposing your own norms.
modules: The principles framework: autonomy, beneficence, justice, fidelity
A shared vocabulary keeps hard conversations precise.
Documentation and consultation as ethical acts
A model turns panic into process.
The minor's assent and the parent's consent
Limits of confidentiality and how to explain them
Trust with a child is built on honest limits.
Boundaries are the container that makes intimacy safe.
Reporting is a moral act done with skill and care.
Ethics lives inside culture and conviction; we must see both.
practicum: Practice takes the form of guided dilemmas.
A personal ethics policy drafted and defended
assessment: A timed dilemma analysis using a named model
tips: Run every dilemma through the same model until it is habit
Keep a consultation log; ethics is a team discipline
When in doubt, slow down and document
integration: Ethics governs every other course in this programme; it is the frame around all your clinical skill.
faith: We hold that integrity before God and before the child are the same integrity. Ethics is faith made careful.
closing: May your conscience be as skilled as your hands, and may no child ever be less safe because of you.
